entries.relational_slices_section: Planner trust and derived access paths
entries.required_rule: Partial unique and derived predicate implication must compare keyword predicates with the source column collation.
entries.unsafe_negative: The same predicate must not imply a case-sensitive partial predicate when only case-insensitive equality would match.
entries.evidence_symbol: relational partial unique predicates honor case-insensitive column collation
entries.coverage_contract: Proves row tuple construction and predicate implication accept case-insensitive matches and reject the opposite predicate.
entries.missing_or_next_evidence: Extend this row when additional collations become accepted derived-access-path inputs.

entries.relational_slices_section: Planner trust and derived access paths
entries.required_rule: Expression partial predicates may be trusted only when typed field/value conditions are implied by query predicates.
entries.unsafe_negative: Expression partial predicates must not be trusted when the same spelling lacks the required source-column collation.
entries.evidence_symbol: relational rows expression partial predicate implication honors source column collation
entries.coverage_contract: Proves expression-predicate implication succeeds for the collation-aware source column and fails for exact comparison.
entries.missing_or_next_evidence: Add rows for type coercion and volatility before enabling broader expression-index planning.

entries.relational_slices_section: Planner trust and derived access paths
entries.required_rule: IS NOT NULL implication must parse JSON null as SQL-null-equivalent and distinguish the string "null" and non-null values.
entries.unsafe_negative: Pretty JSON null and invalid JSON predicates must not imply an IS NOT NULL partial unique predicate.
entries.evidence_symbol: relational partial unique is-not-null implication parses json null literals
entries.coverage_contract: Proves parsed null, string null, numeric, and invalid JSON predicate cases for partial unique implication.
entries.missing_or_next_evidence: Add ordered-composite NULLS FIRST/LAST implication rows before ordered indexes become planner inputs.

entries.relational_slices_section: Planner trust and derived access paths
entries.required_rule: Unique expression tuple derivation must preserve source-column collation and null distinctness semantics.
entries.unsafe_negative: Null tuple components must not collide with non-null expression-derived tuple values.
entries.evidence_symbol: relational unique ast field expressions honor source column collation and null distinctness
entries.coverage_contract: Proves expression tuple equality under source-column collation while keeping absent/null values distinct.
entries.missing_or_next_evidence: Add multi-column ordered null-semantics rows when ordered-composite access paths are promoted.

entries.relational_slices_section: Planner trust and derived access paths
entries.required_rule: A building secondary index cannot be used as a query-answering access path even when its key shape matches.
entries.unsafe_negative: Queries must scan base rows when a building artifact is incomplete or has missing index keys.
entries.evidence_symbol: relational rows query ignores building secondary indexes and scans base rows
entries.coverage_contract: Deletes one matching index key and proves the query still returns both rows through the base-row path.
entries.missing_or_next_evidence: Repeat for derived ordered/expression artifacts after generation metadata is durable.

entries.relational_slices_section: Planner trust and derived access paths
entries.required_rule: Ordered secondary index metadata is not a trusted query-answering path until lifecycle validation is implemented.
entries.unsafe_negative: Queries must ignore ordered secondary indexes and return base-row results when ordered keys are incomplete.
entries.evidence_symbol: relational rows query ignores ordered secondary indexes and scans base rows
entries.coverage_contract: Deletes ordered index keys and proves matching rows remain visible through base-row scanning.
entries.missing_or_next_evidence: Replace with generation/CAS promotion coverage once ordered indexes can be accepted planner paths.

entries.relational_slices_section: Planner trust and derived access paths
entries.required_rule: Partial secondary indexes may be used only when query predicates imply the partial-index predicate.
entries.unsafe_negative: A predicate on the indexed column alone must not use the partial index because it would omit non-matching rows.
entries.evidence_symbol: relational rows query only uses partial secondary index when predicates imply it
entries.coverage_contract: Proves email-only queries return active and inactive rows, while email plus status can use the partial path.
entries.missing_or_next_evidence: Add volatility/type-coercion negatives before expression pushdown becomes planner-driven.
